04_Biodiversity.Rmd

Morrow Zhang

2026-04-28

Scientific Questions of Analysis

Scientific Question: Do hospitalized patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) who have made a recent suicide attempt exhibit higher gut microbial alpha diversity compared to MDD patients without a history of suicide attempts?

Alpha diversity Null hypothesis: There is no difference in gut microbial alpha diversity between hospitalized MDD patients with a recent suicide attempt and those without a history of suicide attempts.

Alternative hypothesis: Hospitalized MDD patients with a recent suicide attempt exhibit higher gut microbial alpha diversity across Hill diversity q = 0, q = 1, and q = 2 compared to MDD patients without a history of suicide attempts. Prior literature suggests that suicide-attempt status is associated with increased abundance of specific bacterial taxa, which may increase microbial richness (q = 0) and alter community evenness and dominance patterns reflected in q = 1 and q = 2.

Set seed and Load Packages

start_time <- Sys.time()
set.seed(238428)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, devtools, patchwork, iNEXT, phyloseq,
               # packages for stats
               ggpubr, rstatix, install = FALSE)

Manual Rarefaction Curves

iNEXT_manual_df <- 
  iNEXT_data$iNextEst$size_based %>%
  dplyr::rename(names = Assemblage) %>%
  left_join(metadata_df, by = c("names" = "Run")) %>%
  mutate(
    AttemptStatus = ifelse(
      grepl("non attempters", source_material_id),
      "Non-attempter",
      "Attempter"
    )
  )


dim(iNEXT_manual_df)
## [1] 5880   47
rarefaction_plot <- 
  iNEXT_manual_df %>%
  # Filter out rows that are calculated with actual sequences (no extrapolated)
  dplyr::filter(Method == "Rarefaction") %>%
  # Now, let's draw the plot! 
  ggplot(aes(x = m, y = qD, color = AttemptStatus, group = names)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(Order.q ~ AttemptStatus, scales = "free") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Attempter" = "red",
    "Non-attempter" = "blue"
  )) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = "Effective Number of ASVs", x = "Number of Sequences") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

rarefaction_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/04_Biodiversity/manual_rarefaction_curves.png",
  plot = rarefaction_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8)

Interpretation 1

Based on both the ggiNEXT and manual rarefaction curve plots, sequencing depth appears sufficient to support reliable diversity estimates across all diversity orders (q = 0, q = 1, and q = 2). For most samples, the rarefaction curves rise rapidly and then approach a plateau, indicating that the majority of detectable diversity has been captured.

Statistical Testing

# Tes if the data is normal 

distinct_metadata_df <- metadata_df
shapiro.test(distinct_metadata_df$AvgSpotLen)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  distinct_metadata_df$AvgSpotLen
## W = 0.64199, p-value = 1.112e-09
obs_div_df <- 
  iNEXT_manual_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Method == "Observed")
glimpse(obs_div_df)

# Test if the data is normal

obs_whole_rich_df <- 
  obs_div_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Order.q == 0)

shapiro.test(obs_whole_rich_df$qD)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  obs_whole_rich_df$qD
## W = 0.97652, p-value = 0.4295

p-value is less than 0.5, which means that my data is not normal

kw_attempt_rich <- 
  obs_whole_rich_df %>%
  kruskal_test(qD ~ AttemptStatus)

kw_attempt_rich
## # A tibble: 1 × 6
##   .y.       n statistic    df     p method        
## * <chr> <int>     <dbl> <int> <dbl> <chr>         
## 1 qD       49      2.01     1 0.157 Kruskal-Wallis

Categorical Analysis

# Add the plot 
attempt_ggboxplot <- 
  ggboxplot(obs_whole_rich_df, x = "AttemptStatus", y = "qD", 
            color = "AttemptStatus", fill = "AttemptStatus", alpha = 0.3,
            outlier.shape = NA) + 
  # Add points
  geom_jitter(aes(color = AttemptStatus)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                                "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                               "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  labs(y = "# of Total ASVs (Richness)") + 
  # Add the KW results 
  labs(subtitle = get_test_label(kw_attempt_rich, detailed = TRUE)) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1))

# Show the plot

attempt_ggboxplot

# save the alpha richness boxplot
ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/04_Biodiversity/alpha_richness_boxplot.png",
  plot = attempt_ggboxplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
# Plot boxplots 

alpha_all_q_plot <- 
  obs_div_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = AttemptStatus, y = qD, fill = AttemptStatus, 
             color = AttemptStatus)) + 
  facet_wrap(.~Order.q, scales = "free_y") + 
  geom_jitter() + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                                "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                               "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  labs(y = "Effective Number of ASVs") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1))

alpha_all_q_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/04_Biodiversity/alpha_diversity_all_q.png",
  plot = alpha_all_q_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
# I use Wilcox instead of ANOVA, because my data is not normal.

obs_rich_df <- 
  obs_div_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Order.q == 0)


wilcox_attempt_rich <- 
  wilcox_test(qD ~ AttemptStatus, data = obs_rich_df, alternative = "greater")


wilcox_attempt_rich
## # A tibble: 1 × 7
##   .y.   group1    group2           n1    n2 statistic      p

obs_shannon_df <-
  obs_div_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Order.q == 1)

wilcox_attempt_shannon <-
  wilcox_test(qD ~ AttemptStatus,
               data = obs_shannon_df, alternative = "greater")

wilcox_attempt_shannon

#Rich 
rich_ggboxplot <- 
  ggboxplot(obs_rich_df, x = "AttemptStatus", y = "qD", 
            color = "AttemptStatus", fill = "AttemptStatus", alpha = 0.3,
            outlier.shape = NA) + 
 
  geom_jitter(aes(color = AttemptStatus)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                                "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                               "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 
  labs(y = "# of Total ASVs (Richness)") + 
  # Add Wilcoxon
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.y = min(obs_rich_df$qD) - 5) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1))


rich_ggboxplot

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/04_Biodiversity/richness_wilcoxon_boxplot.png",
  plot = rich_ggboxplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
# Simpson by AttemptStatus 
simps_ggboxplot <- 
  ggboxplot(obs_simps_df, x = "AttemptStatus", y = "qD", 
            color = "AttemptStatus", fill = "AttemptStatus", alpha = 0.3,
            outlier.shape = NA) + 


  geom_jitter(aes(color = AttemptStatus)) + 

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                                "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Attempter" = "red",
                               "Non-attempter" = "blue")) + 

  labs(y = "# of Dominant ASVs (Simpson)") +

  # Add Wilcoxon
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     label.y = min(obs_simps_df$qD) - 2) + 

  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1))

simps_ggboxplot

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/04_Biodiversity/simpson_wilcoxon_boxplot.png",
  plot = simps_ggboxplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
rich_ggboxplot + simps_ggboxplot

Interpretation 2

Wilcoxon rank-sum tests using a one-sided alternative hypothesis showed no significant differences in alpha diversity between suicide attempters and non-attempters across all diversity levels. When q = 0, p value is 0.0799. When q = 1, p value is 0.245. When q = 2, p value is 0.319. Overall, these results fail to reject the null hypothesis and indicate that hospitalized MDD patients with recent suicide attempts do not exhibit significantly higher gut microbial alpha diversity compared to those without a history of suicide attempts.

Interpretation 3

I statistically tested my scientific question using Wilcoxon rank-sum tests to compare alpha diversity between suicide attempters and non-attempters. I used this test because my variable of interest, Attempt Status, is categorical, and my alpha diversity data were not normally distributed, making a non-parametric test more appropriate than ANOVA. I conducted separate one-sided Wilcoxon tests for richness (q = 0), Shannon diversity (q = 1), and Simpson diversity (q = 2), using an alternative hypothesis that alpha diversity would be greater in attempters compared to non-attempters. This allowed me to statistically evaluate whether gut microbial diversity differed between groups across all ASVs, common ASVs, and dominant ASVs.
